Team / Sarah —

Quick note: Finance and Sales Ops worked through a small set of clarifications to our forecast categories (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline). The changes are intentionally narrow — focused on stage mapping and the criteria reps should use when moving deals between Commit and Best Case. We want to avoid variability across AE cohorts ahead of quarter-end.

What I'm asking:
- Please review the attached one-page refresher (forecast_stage_refresher_v1.pdf) before the session.
- Update any deals you own that you believe are mis-categorized by EOD Wednesday. In particular, RW-4582 currently shows as Best Case but based on the latest legal timeline it should be Commit.
- Join one of the office hours sessions this week for a live walkthrough and Q&A — pick the slot on the calendar link below. I will run a short 20-minute demo and then take questions.

Why this matters: consistent category definitions materially change our weekly rollup and allocation to commit coverage. Small classification differences add up at the forecast level, and we need predictable inputs into finance.
